name: Rogue Anoikis Telemetry
description:
The Federation will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Federation Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30003788>Intaki</url>.

Collected by Rogue Drones that have infested Anoikis, this telemetry includes evidence of hyperspace fluctuations. Mapping these could help identify the details of the Emergent Artifact’s manifestation.
